headline: 10 killed in Inani resort fire; family of 4 still missing
summary: A devastating blaze at TUPTUP Resto and Resort in Cox's Bazar has left 10 dead, with a Dhaka-based family of four feared missing.
details: A massive fire broke out at 6:30 am on Saturday at TUPTUP Resto and Resort in Inani's Patuartek, Cox's Bazar. The blaze took two hours to bring under control, resulting in at least 10 deaths.
Among the victims, six members of a single family were killed. Authorities recovered 10 bodies, but they are charred beyond recognition, requiring DNA tests for identification.
A family of four from Dhaka is currently missing. Nahidur Rahman Tuhin, an official at Grand Power Limited, is missing along with his wife Afsana and their two daughters, aged 7 and 3.
Nahidur had booked a room at the resort from October 16 to 18. His relatives and colleagues in Dhaka are anxious as they have been unable to reach the family since the fire.
Cox's Bazar Additional Police Superintendent Ahidur Rahman confirmed that Nahid is missing, while the Fire Service reported that some bodies were recovered from a toilet area.
DNA samples are being collected to identify the victims, as facial recognition is impossible due to the extent of the burns.
caption:
10 dead, and a family of 4 still missing. A vacation in Cox's Bazar turned into a nightmare.

A massive fire broke out at 6:30 am on Saturday at TUPTUP Resto and Resort in Inani's Patuartek, Cox's Bazar. The blaze took two hours to bring under control, resulting in at least 10 deaths.

Among the victims, six members of a single family were killed. Authorities recovered 10 bodies, but they are charred beyond recognition, requiring DNA tests for identification.

A family of four from Dhaka is currently missing. Nahidur Rahman Tuhin, an official at Grand Power Limited, is missing along with his wife Afsana and their two daughters, aged 7 and 3.

Nahidur had booked a room at the resort from October 16 to 18. His relatives and colleagues in Dhaka are anxious as they have been unable to reach the family since the fire.

Cox's Bazar Additional Police Superintendent Ahidur Rahman confirmed that Nahid is missing, while the Fire Service reported that some bodies were recovered from a toilet area.

DNA samples are being collected to identify the victims, as facial recognition is impossible due to the extent of the burns.

headline_marked: Youth [[arrested over journalist Alif murder]] in Netrokona
headline: Youth arrested over journalist Alif murder in Netrokona
summary: Police arrested 22-year-old Opurba, who allegedly carried the weapons bag during the shooting death of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir Alif.
details: Police have arrested a 22-year-old youth named Opurba from Durgapur municipal town in Netrokona on suspicion of involvement in the shooting death of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir, alias Alif Fakir.
Opurba was arrested early Saturday morning following a tip-off. Police claim he was present at the scene during the killing and was carrying the bag containing the weapons used in the crime.
According to Durgapur Police Station OC Khandaker Shaker Ahmed, Opurba is the nephew of the prime suspect, who is described as a 'contract for hire' shooter.
Investigation reveals that the firearms used in the murder were kept in Opurba's custody. The suspect had been hiding during the day to evade arrest and only came out after midnight.
Opurba was also an accused in a previous case where journalist Alif Fakir was critically injured by sharp weapons in November last year at the Teribazar Ghat area.
Journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir Alif was shot dead on Thursday, October 15, around 8:15 pm while returning home after having tea at a stall in the Telanjia area of Durgapur upazila.
The victim's wife has filed a murder case with Durgapur Police Station, accusing seven to eight unidentified individuals over the killing.
caption:
A 22-year-old youth has been arrested for allegedly carrying the weapons bag during the murder of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir Alif.

Police have arrested a 22-year-old youth named Opurba from Durgapur municipal town in Netrokona on suspicion of involvement in the shooting death of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir, alias Alif Fakir.

Opurba was arrested early Saturday morning following a tip-off. Police claim he was present at the scene during the killing and was carrying the bag containing the weapons used in the crime.

According to Durgapur Police Station OC Khandaker Shaker Ahmed, Opurba is the nephew of the prime suspect, who is described as a 'contract for hire' shooter.

Investigation reveals that the firearms used in the murder were kept in Opurba's custody. The suspect had been hiding during the day to evade arrest and only came out after midnight.

Opurba was also an accused in a previous case where journalist Alif Fakir was critically injured by sharp weapons in November last year at the Teribazar Ghat area.

Journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir Alif was shot dead on Thursday, October 15, around 8:15 pm while returning home after having tea at a stall in the Telanjia area of Durgapur upazila.

The victim's wife has filed a murder case with Durgapur Police Station, accusing seven to eight unidentified individuals over the killing.
